title: GroundingPack
description: The machine-readable form of the KGP grounding-pack.md §2 envelope: a content-addressed, self-describing bundle of knowledge scoped to one or more worlds (KINP §5). Reconciled onto the KGP §2 envelope (kgp_version / pack_id / producer / worlds / kind / basis / dialect + entities / assertions / links / provenance / manifest) — US-4 of ADR-0003. Legacy's grounding-pack identity is RETIRED here: its hard-coded `source` const discriminator and the free-string `packId` are dropped in favour of a KINP `producer` namespace + a content-addressed `pack_id` (KGP §2.1), and legacy's {contractVersion, packId, generatedAt, source, domains, prologFacts, licenseManifest} envelope keys are replaced by the KGP §2 shape. Exact on the envelope, ids, provenance, license; permissive on entity fields.

kgp_version.description: The KGP spec version (semver) this pack was produced against — e.g. "0.4.0". Supersedes legacy's single `contractVersion`/`CONTRACT_VERSION` and the downstream `insimul-grounding-v1` const, both renamed onto `kgp_version` (ADR-0003 §Downstream).

pack_id.description: Content-addressed pack id (KGP §2.1): sha256-<hex> of the canonical manifest ⊕ sorted(entities) ⊕ sorted(assertions) ⊕ sorted(links). Byte-reproducible — two producers emitting the same knowledge emit the same pack_id. Replaces legacy's free-string `packId`.

producer.description: The producing project's KINP namespace, e.g. `pinakes`, `analyzer`, `insimul`. Replaces legacy's hard-coded `source` const discriminator — any KINP namespace may produce a pack, not a single hard-coded source (ADR-0003).

worlds.description: The world CURIEs this pack is scoped to (KINP §5), e.g. `pinakes:world:consensus-reality`. Replaces legacy's free-string `domains`.

kind.description: Directionality (KGP §6): a full `snapshot` or a `delta` applied against `basis`.

basis.description: For kind=delta, the `pack_id` this delta applies against (KGP §6); null for a snapshot.

dialect.description: Pack-level logic dialect (KGP §2 envelope, §5) — the highest logic tier a consumer may evaluate over this pack's assertions. NOT an egress or trust field; local-only is excluded here because it is an egress class, not a dialect tier (KGP §5).

entities.description: The referenced entity records (KGP §2): each keyed by a `csid` — structurally the KINP entity CURIE (identity.md §7.1) — never a legacy ad-hoc id.

assertions.description: The KINP assertion envelopes (identity.md §7.1) this pack carries. Each `id` is the content-addressed claim id (KGP §3), so identical claims dedup/merge across producers. Replaces legacy's untyped `prologFacts` strings — Prolog remains a §4 serialization, not the envelope shape.

links.description: Equivalence + lifecycle relations (same_as / based_on / part_of / instance_of / retracts / supersedes) — themselves assertions using KINP's reserved relations (identity.md §7.1), so each `id` is a content-addressed claim id.

provenance.description: W3C-PROV-shaped activities/agents referenced by the assertions (KGP §2, §7).

manifest.description: The self-describing pack manifest (KGP §2): record counts, creation time, optional signing, and the license admission policy (§7.1).

license_policy.description: The license admission allowlist (KGP §7.1): license id -> record count; must cover every record. Replaces legacy's top-level `licenseManifest`.
